overview: The City Council approved a $3.4 million loan for a public library project, corrected a zoning ordinance error regarding use variances, and held an extensive discussion regarding sanitation and safety concerns at Walkland Court.

items.title: Medford Public Library Loan Order
items.summary: Approved a loan order of $3,466,567 for the Medford Public Library project on its third reading.

items.title: Budget Transfer and Union MOU
items.summary: Approved a $54,000 budget transfer after the administration confirmed that a specific position had been appropriately negotiated out of the union.

items.title: Commendations and Recognitions
items.summary: Congratulated John Costas for being named Citizen of the Year and recognized incoming and outgoing leadership for the Chamber of Commerce.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Amori Pizza and Kitchen
items.summary: Approved a license for Amori Pizza and Kitchen located at 509A High Street.

items.title: Event Food Truck Approvals
items.summary: Approved food trucks for several community festivals, with an amendment requiring the administration to provide specific street locations for the Circle the Square event.

items.title: Condolence Resolution
items.summary: Passed a resolution expressing condolences for the family of Hugh McIsaac.

items.title: Public Trash Receptacles and Street Cleanliness
items.summary: Approved a request for the DPW to report on the cost and placement of decorative barrels, solar-powered recycling units, and cigarette receptacles in business districts.

items.title: Walkland Court Living Conditions
items.summary: Discussed reports of bed bug infestations, unsanitary conditions, and resident intimidation at Walkland Court, requesting administration attendance at a tenant meeting and updates on maintenance policies.

items.title: Correction of Zoning Ordinances Regarding Use Variances
items.summary: Approved correcting the city's codified ordinances to clarify that use variances are permitted, following a legal opinion from the City Solicitor that their omission was a clerical error.

items.title: Announcements and Minutes
items.summary: Noted upcoming fundraisers and community film screenings, and approved the meeting records from April 17, 2018.

items.title: McNally Park Flag Replacement
items.summary: Requested that the city replace the tattered flag at McNally Park.
